q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_heater.lang_desc: electric radiator, which is located in the same region as the wardrobe and the picture. it is positioned below the picture and to the right of the wardrobe.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: wooden cabinet in the room with a window. locate the cabinet relative to the other objects as references.
wooden cabinet with a tv on it. the cabinet is located to the left of the armchair, above the couch, below the picture, and to the right of the box of tissues.
wooden cabinet located next to the armchair, kitchen appliance, decorative plate, and book.
wooden cabinet with a sink and a mirror. it is located next to the folding chair, towards the left side of the frame.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_bathtub.lang_desc: bathtub in the bathroom. it is located next to the shower curtain and the towel.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_bathroom towel.lang_desc: bathroom towel. start by locating the shower curtain in front of you, then turn towards the picture on your right. the bathroom towel is located below the picture, towards the left side. look for a white towel with a red and white checkered pattern.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_sink.lang_desc: sink, which is a stainless steel sink, in the kitchen area. the sink is located near the oven and stove, kitchen lower cabinet, dishwasher, and kitchen extractor. additionally, the sink is close to the tray and paper towel.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_oven and stove.lang_desc: oven and stove in the kitchen. the oven and stove are located on the kitchen top, towards the right side of the kitchen cabinet. they are made of stainless steel.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_wardrobe.lang_desc: wardrobe. the wardrobe is located to the right of the armchair and below the window curtain. look for a wooden wardrobe with a wooden floor and a wooden door.
wardrobe that is spatially relative to the heater and window curtain. it has a wooden door and a window.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: bed located on the left side of the wardrobe, near the side table and the window curtain.
double bed located near a nightstand, pillow, and a book.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_shower cabin.lang_desc: shower cabin with a broken glass door located next to the window curtain, to the right of the sink, and below the bathroom towel.

q3zU7Yy5E5s.basis.glb_bag.lang_desc: bag located to the right of the toilet paper, below the window curtain, and above the toilet brush holder.
